# 🚀 Release Readiness Checklist

## Documentation
- [ ] README and documentation index are current.
- [ ] Diagrams reflect actual behavior or are clearly marked as proposals.
- [ ] Known issues are accurate.
- [ ] Changelog is updated.

## Data and licensing
- [ ] Dataset source and exact provenance are documented honestly.
- [ ] License and attribution requirements are reviewed.
- [ ] No private or identifiable data is included.
- [ ] Data validation has been run.

## Engineering
- [ ] Documentation validation has been run.
- [ ] Automated tests have been run.
- [ ] Notebook execution status is reported accurately.
- [ ] Environment versions are recorded.
- [ ] Dependencies and workflow permissions are reviewed.

## Safety
- [ ] No unsupported accuracy, clinical, or regulatory claims.
- [ ] Non-clinical-use notice remains prominent.
- [ ] Remaining risks and limitations are disclosed.

## Release record
- [ ] Commit SHA and tag recorded.
- [ ] Release notes describe actual changes.
- [ ] Rollback approach is understood.
